lines.trans: Mei! Look at you standing steady at the stove on both feet!
Resting two days on those pillows worked wonders—not a single twinge today!
Good thing too, chef, because we just brought back forty fresh lemons from the market.
Forty lemons works out right to bake four big trays of almond lemon tart for six o'clock!
How many neighbours do you think will actually come tonight, Mei?
When free music and warm bread meet, word travels mighty fast on Wutong Lane!
I already sliced ten lemons; Qing is beating the eggs and white sugar.
Did you check the big red label on the sugar jar clearly first, Qing?
Checked twice and tasted a pinch! Sweet as summer!
What about serving twenty-four cups of hot tea all at once, Mei—will there be enough?
Two big pots of black tea, two pots of fresh courtyard mint tea, and hot milk.
Into the oven goes tray number one—six o'clock, we are ready!

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！

meanings.note: Pinyin: yì diǎn. Before a noun, means 'a little bit of' (一点糖); after an adjective, 'a bit more' (快一点).

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng. Used both as a directional verb/complement ('up, onto') and location word ('on top of').

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù. Standard negation for present/future/habitual verbs and adjectives; shifts to bú before a 4th tone (不是 bú shì).

examples.text: 停电的时候，纸还能用。

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！

meanings.note: Pinyin: gè. Most common Mandarin measure word (量词), placed between a number/demonstrative and a noun (一个人, 这个).

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。

meanings.note: Pinyin: yě. Always stands directly before the verb or adjective, never at the end of a clause.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。

examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kuài. As an adjective/adverb, 'fast/quickly'; in 快…了, 'about to'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 小晴，快看里面！这不是我的箱子！
examples.trans: Qing, look inside quickly! This is not my case!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ. First-person singular pronoun; add 的 for 'my' (我的) and 们 for 'we/us' (我们).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ men. First-person plural pronoun; add 的 for 'our' (我们的).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

meanings.en: hit; make (a call); give (a score); fetch
meanings.note: Pinyin: dǎ. Light verb forming dozens of everyday expressions (打电话 'make a phone call').

examples.text: 小晴，马上给火车站失物处打电话。
examples.trans: Qing, call the train station lost-and-found office right away.

examples.text: 我正在打……您好，请问有人找蓝色行李箱吗？
examples.trans: I am calling now... Hello, excuse me, is anyone looking for a blue suitcase?

撮.gloss: pinch (measure word for salt, tea leaves, or powder)

meanings.en: pinch (measure word for salt, tea leaves, or powder)
meanings.note: Pinyin: cuō. Classifier for a tiny quantity picked up between thumb and fingertips (一小撮盐 'a small pinch of salt').

examples.text: 用细绳绑两小枝新鲜香草，最后再往汤里放一小撮盐。
examples.trans: Tie two small sprigs of fresh herbs with string, and finally add a small pinch of salt to the soup.

examples.text: 泡茶的时候抓一小撮干薄荷叶放进壶里，香气马上就出来了。
examples.trans: Toss a small pinch of dried mint leaves into the pot when brewing tea and the aroma rises at once.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīn xiān. Describes fresh fruit, fresh juice, or fresh herbs.

examples.text: 好。端上去之前，在上面撒这些新鲜绿香草。
examples.trans: Good. Before serving them, sprinkle these fresh green herbs on top.

examples.text: 闻闻看！热面包、热炒蛋，还有新鲜香草。
examples.trans: Smell that! Warm bread, hot scrambled eggs, and fresh herbs.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǒu. Expresses both possession ('I have') and existence ('there is'); ALWAYS negated with 没 (没有), never 不.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xìng rén. Combines 杏 ('apricot/almond') + 仁 ('nut kernel').

examples.text: 小美端来了一盘刚出炉的温热杏仁饼干。
examples.trans: Mei brought over a plate of warm almond biscuits fresh from the oven.

examples.text: 用杏仁粉做的柠檬挞底吃起来特别香酥。
examples.trans: A lemon tart crust made with ground almonds tastes wonderfully crisp and nutty.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lái. Movement toward the speaker, as main verb or directional complement (进来 'come in').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

杯.gloss: measure word for cups and glasses

meanings.en: measure word for cups and glasses
meanings.note: Pinyin: bēi. Counts cups of tea, coffee, water, or juice (一杯热茶 'a cup of hot tea').

examples.text: 太客气了，周经理。半杯就好。
examples.trans: How polite of you, Manager Zhou. Half a glass is fine.

examples.text: 坐下吧，小晴！早上你跑了半条街，喝杯咖啡。
examples.trans: Sit down, Qing! You ran half the street this morning—drink a cup of coffee.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhěn tou. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个枕头 ('a pillow').

examples.text: 储藏室里有两个软枕头和一块蓝地毯！
examples.trans: In the storeroom there are two soft pillows and a blue rug!

examples.text: 小晴，把床单角塞紧！放上两个软枕头。
examples.trans: Qing, tuck the sheet corner tight! On go the two soft pillows.

meanings.note: Pinyin: níng méng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个柠檬 ('a lemon').

examples.text: 他爷爷会切热柠檬蛋糕，上面撒一层白糖粉！
examples.trans: His grandfather sliced warm lemon cake with a dusting of powdered sugar on top!

examples.text: 啊！黄色柠檬糖霜——每个星期五我们俩都抢边角那一块！
examples.trans: Oh! Yellow lemon glaze—every single Friday the two of us fought over the corner piece!

meanings.note: Pinyin: níng méng tà. Combines 柠檬 ('lemon') + 挞 ('tart', phonetic loan from English 'tart').

examples.text: 星期二我们要修好琴键，还要烤星期三的柠檬挞！
examples.trans: On Tuesday we will fix the piano key and bake Wednesday's lemon tarts!

examples.text: 酸甜清香的杏仁柠檬挞成了咖啡角的招牌甜点。
examples.trans: Sweet-tart, fragrant almond lemon tart became the café corner's signature dessert.

meanings.note: Pinyin: biāo qiān. Combines 标 ('mark/sign') + 签 ('inscribed slip/tag'); measure word: 张 (zhāng); verb: 贴标签 ('stick on a label').

examples.text: 睡觉以前，先把那两个神秘白罐子都贴上清楚的大红标签。
examples.trans: Before going to bed, stick clear bright red labels onto both of those mysterious white jars.

examples.text: 贴好“白糖”和“海盐”的标签以后，早上做点心就再也不会拿错了。
examples.trans: Once the 'Sugar' and 'Sea Salt' labels are stuck on, nobody will mix them up during morning baking.

examples.text: 歇一会儿吧。
examples.trans: Rest for a while.

examples.text: 我们需要歇一下。
examples.trans: We need to rest a bit.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng zài. Placed before a verb to mark an action happening at this very moment.

examples.text: 我正在打……您好，请问有人找蓝色行李箱吗？
examples.trans: I am calling now... Hello, excuse me, is anyone looking for a blue suitcase?

examples.text: 老板正在开锁呢！别挂电话，等我一秒钟。
examples.trans: The owner is unlocking it right now! Stay on the phone, wait one second.

meanings.en: just right; happen to; right on the dot
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng hǎo. Marks a lucky coincidence or exact fit.

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

examples.text: 他拿旧阀门比对了——架子上正好还剩两个！
examples.trans: He matched it against the old valve—he has two left on the shelf!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiāo xi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个好消息 ('a piece of good news').

examples.text: 宋老师，真对不起，那边还没有消息。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, I am truly sorry; they have no news over there yet.

examples.text: 坏消息。老热水器上的铜压力阀门裂了。
examples.trans: Bad news. The brass pressure valve on the old water heater cracked.

related.gloss: a piece of good news (measure word 个)

meanings.note: In 全清, means background/account checks came back 100% clean.

examples.text: 所有嘉宾的背景核查都已经是全清状态。
examples.trans: Background checks on every guest came back completely clean.

examples.text: 清晨的空气格外清，让人精神一振。
examples.trans: Morning air is extra clear and refreshing.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lú zi. Combines 炉 ('stove/furnace') + nominal suffix 子 (zi); measure word: 台 (tái) or 个 (gè).

examples.text: 小美！你看你，两只脚稳稳站在炉子前了！
examples.trans: Mei! Look at you standing steady in front of the stove on both feet!

examples.text: 炉子上的大铁锅里正咕嘟咕嘟煮着红扁豆汤。
examples.trans: In the big pot on the stove, red lentil soup is simmering away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diǎn zhōng. Combines 点 ('hour point on the clock') + 钟 ('clock/bell'), slightly fuller and more rhythmic than bare 点.

examples.text: 四十个柠檬，正好烤四大盘六点钟的杏仁柠檬挞！
examples.trans: Forty lemons is just right to bake four big trays of almond lemon tart for six o'clock!

examples.text: 每天早上六点钟，厨房里就会飘出热面包的香味。
examples.trans: Every morning at six o'clock, the aroma of warm bread drifts out of the kitchen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kǎo. Used for baking bread, rolls, and cakes in an oven.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

examples.text: 多烤几块边角，好姑娘！
examples.trans: Bake plenty of corner pieces, dear girl!

meanings.note: Pinyin: kǎo xiāng. Measure word (量词): 台, e.g. 一台烤箱 ('an oven').

examples.text: 还好烤箱里的面团已经放进去了。
examples.trans: My dough is already in the oven, at least.

examples.text: 宋老师早！我的肉桂卷刚出烤箱。
examples.trans: Morning, Teacher Song! My cinnamon rolls just came out of the oven.

meanings.note: Pinyin: rè. Describes hot tea, hot water, or warm weather.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: niú nǎi. Measure word (量词): 杯 (bēi), e.g. 一杯牛奶 ('a glass of milk').

examples.text: 送牛奶的车在城外坏了。你们看冰箱！
examples.trans: The milk delivery van broke down outside town. Look at the fridge!

examples.text: 只有一点点牛奶、两个鸡蛋，一点黄油都没有！
examples.trans: Only a tiny bit of milk, two eggs, and no butter at all!

related.gloss: a glass of milk (measure word 杯)

meanings.note: Pinyin: tián. Describes sweet pastries, fruit, or tea with honey.

examples.text: 那是海盐咸黄油！甜果酱面包卷要无盐黄油！
examples.trans: That is sea-salt butter! Sweet jam rolls need unsalted butter!

examples.text: 咸黄油能配甜草莓果酱吗？
examples.trans: Can salted butter go with sweet strawberry jam?

examples.text: 我的头很疼。
examples.trans: My head hurts a lot.

examples.text: 腿疼。
examples.trans: Leg hurts.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bái. Describes white paper, sugar, or tablecloths.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

examples.text: 看，把手上贴着一个白信封。
examples.trans: Look, there is a white envelope taped onto the handle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Links modifiers or owners to nouns (我的书 'my book', 安静的院子 'quiet courtyard').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

盘.gloss: tray; plate; dish (measure word for trays of baked goods or dishes)

meanings.en: tray; plate; dish (measure word for trays of baked goods or dishes)
meanings.note: Pinyin: pán. Classifier for trays, pans, or plates of food (一盘柠檬挞 'a tray/plate of lemon tart', 四大盘 'four big trays').

examples.text: 四十个柠檬，正好烤四大盘六点钟的杏仁柠檬挞！
examples.trans: Forty lemons works out right to bake four big trays of almond lemon tart for six o'clock!

examples.text: 幸好小美多烤了两盘热乎乎的肉桂卷。
examples.trans: Luckily Mei baked two extra trays of piping-hot cinnamon rolls.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn. Covers looking at something, reading silently, or visiting someone; add 见/到 for 'catch sight of'.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhēn. Exclamatory adverb before adjectives (真好！ 'How nice!') or adjective 'genuine'.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

examples.text: 真奇怪！我们坐同一班早火车到同一个区。
examples.trans: How strange! We rode the very same morning train to the same district.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhe. Placed right after a verb to show a state or posture continues (门开着 'the door stands open').

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wén wěn. Reduplicated adverb describing steady hands or footing.

examples.text: 火苗亮了——稳稳的蓝火，正合适。
examples.trans: The flame is lit—steady blue fire, right as it should be.

examples.text: 她双手稳稳地端起盛满热茶的托盘。
examples.trans: With both hands she lifted the tray of hot tea steadily.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhàn. As a verb, 'stand' (站在旁边); as a noun, 'station/stop' (火车站).

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

examples.text: 听得很清楚。你站在小石头喷泉旁边吗？
examples.trans: Loud and clear. Are you standing beside the little stone fountain?

meanings.note: ordinal number

examples.text: 我是传媒学院的研究生，年级第一名。
examples.trans: I am a graduate student at the Media College, first in my year.

examples.text: 我是传媒学院的研究生，年级第一名。
examples.trans: I am a graduate student at the Media College, first in my year.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guǎn yòng. Colloquial stative adjective/verb 管 ('govern/take care of') + 用 ('use/function').

examples.text: 垫着枕头歇了两天真管用——今天一点也不疼了！
examples.trans: Resting two days propped on pillows really worked wonders—it doesn't hurt a bit today!

examples.text: 老陈修门窗的小办法简单又管用。
examples.trans: Chen's little tricks for fixing doors and windows are simple and effective.

meanings.note: Pinyin: táng. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块糖 ('a piece of candy / sugar cube').

examples.text: 请给我不加糖的红茶，再来一片热面包。
examples.trans: Black tea without added sugar, please, and one slice of warm bread.

examples.text: 太好了！请加牛奶和一点糖。
examples.trans: Wonderful! With milk and a little sugar, please.

related.gloss: a piece of candy / sugar cube (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: hóng. Describes the color red; note that 红茶 is what English calls 'black tea'.

examples.text: 告诉他们，我箱子上面口袋里有红丝带！
examples.trans: Tell them there is a red ribbon inside the top pocket of my case!

examples.text: 我的行李箱！快打开上面口袋……对，红丝带！
examples.trans: My suitcase! Let me open the top pocket... yes, the red ribbon!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hóng chá. Measure word (量词): 杯 (bēi), e.g. 一杯红茶 ('a cup of black tea').

examples.text: 宋老师早！您想喝咖啡还是红茶？
examples.trans: Morning, Teacher Song! Would you like coffee or black tea?

examples.text: 请给我不加糖的红茶，再来一片热面包。
examples.trans: Black tea without added sugar, please, and one slice of warm bread.

related.gloss: a cup of black tea (measure word 杯)

罐.gloss: jar of; pot of; tin of

meanings.en: jar of; pot of; tin of
meanings.note: Pinyin: guàn. Serves both as a noun (罐子 'jar/crock') and as a measure word for jars or tins (两罐蜂蜜 'two jars of honey').

examples.text: 竹篮子里装着两罐沉甸甸的百花蜂蜜。
examples.trans: Packed inside the bamboo basket are two heavy jars of wildflower honey.

examples.text: 小美做了四小罐草莓果酱放在厨房架子上。
examples.trans: Mei made four small jars of strawberry jam and set them on the kitchen shelf.

meanings.note: Lower extremity of the leg.

examples.text: 蹲了太久，我的脚都有点麻了。
examples.trans: After squatting so long, my foot went a bit numb.

examples.text: 走了一整天路，脚特别酸。
examples.trans: After walking all day, my feet are really sore.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chá. Measure word (量词): 杯 (bēi), e.g. 一杯茶 ('a cup of tea').

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 先喝杯热茶，吃个肉桂卷坐十分钟吧！
examples.trans: Have a cup of hot tea and a cinnamon roll for ten minutes first!

related.gloss: a cup of tea (measure word 杯)

meanings.note: Pinyin: bò he chá. Measure word (量词): 壶, e.g. 一壶薄荷茶 ('a pot of mint tea').

examples.text: 宋老师，给您热薄荷茶和蜂蜜。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, here is hot mint tea and honey for you.

examples.text: 晚饭后喝一壶热薄荷茶最助眠了。
examples.trans: A pot of hot mint tea after dinner helps you sleep soundly.

related.gloss: a pot of mint tea (measure word 壶)

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn. Appears in farewells (再见, 明天见) and as result complement of perception (看见, 听见).

examples.text: 晚安，小晴。明天早餐见。
examples.trans: Good night, Qing. See you at breakfast tomorrow.

examples.text: 老陈，听得见吗？我刚经过绿药店！
examples.trans: Chen, can you hear me? I just passed the green pharmacy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jué de. Introduces personal impressions or feelings.

examples.text: 周经理的意思是……希望每位客人都觉得有十分满意！
examples.trans: What Manager Zhou means is... we hope every guest feels ten-out-of-ten satisfied!

examples.text: 我觉得这间向阳的书房最安静。
examples.trans: I think this sunny study is the quietest room of all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hái. Everyday adverb meaning 'still' (还在), 'not yet' (还没), or 'even more' after 比.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

examples.text: 宋老师，真对不起，那边还没有消息。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, I am truly sorry; they have no news over there yet.

meanings.en: and also; in addition; still have
meanings.note: Pinyin: hái yǒu. Adds another item to a list ('plus…').

examples.text: 只有裙子、乐谱，还有我最喜欢的茶杯！
examples.trans: Only dresses, sheet music, and my favourite teacup!

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jìn. Movement into an enclosed space (请进 'come in!', 倒进 'pour into').

examples.text: 小晴，把热水倒进茶壶里，他们来了！
examples.trans: Qing, pour the hot water into the teapot—here they come!

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

遍.gloss: time (once through, from start to finish)

meanings.en: time (once through, from start to finish)
meanings.note: Pinyin: biàn. Counts complete run-throughs of an action (再算一遍 'count it through once more'); compare 次 for simple occurrences.

examples.text: 等等……让我再算一遍。整个房间只要这么一点钱？
examples.trans: Wait... let me add it up again. The whole room needs only this much money?

examples.text: 请您再说一遍，好吗？
examples.trans: Could you say that once more, please?

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà. Distal demonstrative before measure words (那个 'that one'); at clause start, means 'then / well then'.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lín jū. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位邻居 ('a neighbor').

examples.text: 超过八十年的小院建筑，只要一楼每天服务街坊邻居，禁止改成私人办公室。
examples.trans: Any courtyard building over eighty years old may not become private offices as long as the ground floor serves neighbours daily.

examples.text: 每天服务街坊邻居——就像对公众开放的早间咖啡馆？！
examples.trans: Serves neighbours daily—like a morning café open to the public?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 里面 ('the inside').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuàn zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个院子 ('a courtyard').

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jí shì. Traditional open-air neighbourhood or farmers' market (星期六集市 'Saturday market').

examples.text: 星期六一早，小晴和小美提着竹篮去逛集市。
examples.trans: First thing Saturday morning, Qing and Mei carry bamboo baskets to browse the street market.

examples.text: 集市上的本地蜂蜜和黄柠檬比超市新鲜多了。
examples.trans: Local honey and yellow lemons at the street market are much fresher than in supermarkets.

meanings.note: Pinyin: miàn bāo. Measure word (量词): 片 (piàn), e.g. 一片面包 ('a slice of bread').

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 闻闻看！热面包、热炒蛋，还有新鲜香草。
examples.trans: Smell that! Warm bread, hot scrambled eggs, and fresh herbs.

related.gloss: a slice of bread (measure word 片)

meanings.note: Pinyin: yīn yuè. Measure word (量词): 首 (shǒu), e.g. 一首音乐 ('a piece of music').

examples.text: 一点回声也没有！木头和玻璃让音乐更好听。
examples.trans: No echo at all! Wood and glass make music sound even better.

examples.text: 每个星期五六点！整条街的人都来这儿喝茶听音乐！
examples.trans: Every Friday at six! People from the whole street came here for tea and music!

related.gloss: a piece of music (measure word 首)

meanings.note: Pinyin: jī dàn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个鸡蛋 ('an egg').

examples.text: 只有一点点牛奶、两个鸡蛋，一点黄油都没有！
examples.trans: Only a tiny bit of milk, two eggs, and no butter at all!

examples.text: 三瓶牛奶、二十个鸡蛋、黄油、奶酪和红苹果！
examples.trans: Three bottles of milk, twenty eggs, butter, cheese, and red apples!
